question.problem: A large bottle of tempera paint has a volume of $1\,\textrm{L}.$ What is this volume in milliliters?
question.worked_solution:
A table showing the metric units of volume is given below.

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Liter | $\textrm{L}$ | --- |
| Milliliter | $\textrm{mL}$ | $1,000\,\textrm{mL} = 1\,\textrm{L}$ |

So, $1\,\textrm{L}$ is equivalent to $1\,000\,\textrm{mL}.$
